abort_rules: prediction artifact contains own outcome/settlement/market field
Layer4 model or calibrator hash mismatch
protected prediction artifact changes on deterministic regeneration
scoring implementation defect discovered after first protected outcome score => abort V1 and create V2; do not patch V1 result
post_result_rule: no model, calibration, support, market-source, horizon, disagreement threshold or line-selection change may be made inside this protected experiment after outcomes are scored

prediction_phase.corners_nb2_alpha: frozen Layer4 common alpha; no protected refit

dynamic_walk_forward.pre_protected_history: all eligible PIT history strictly before each fixture
dynamic_walk_forward.protected_updates: an earlier protected fixture may update target state only after its entire same-kickoff forecast batch has been emitted
dynamic_walk_forward.same_kickoff_rule: all forecasts at identical kickoff are emitted from the same pre-kickoff state before any outcome at that kickoff updates state

leakage_sentinels: perturb current fixture outcome => its prediction unchanged
perturb any future fixture outcome => all earlier predictions unchanged
permute outcomes among same-kickoff fixtures => all predictions at that kickoff unchanged
prediction_phase.ood_and_support_thresholds: frozen Layer4 thresholds/support bins; no protected re-estimation
prediction_phase.protected_fixture_universe: all 317 frozen PROTECTED fixtures, regardless of market coverage

similar_context_goals.scaler_and_prior: refit deterministically from earlier-only eligible rows at each kickoff; no hyperparameter tuning
similar_context_goals.training_rows: same-competition PIT rows with target outcome strictly earlier than prediction kickoff

purpose: one-time protected evaluation of frozen standalone p_model plus separately frozen sparse Layer5 market-relative subset

scoring_phase.closing_line: report only if a genuine QFE-owned pre-kickoff close can be bound under existing semantics; missing close remains missing

metrics: flat one-unit PnL if valid selected entry price exists

market_relative_scorecard.coverage_label: must report exact n; current frozen market manifest is known to be extremely sparse
market_relative_scorecard.inferential_claims: forbidden when sample is too small; no bootstrap/significance theatre
market_relative_scorecard.primary_market_probability: frozen proportional no-vig probability from manifest
market_relative_scorecard.universe: only valid market objects in frozen Layer5 matched-market manifest; no source/horizon expansion after outcomes

scoring_phase.outcome_source: canonical regulation-time ResearchMatch labels bound to frozen corpus/chronology

standalone_global_scorecard.CORNERS_SIDE: fixture-balanced: HOME/AWAY each 50%, six lines equal within role
standalone_global_scorecard.GOALS_TOTAL: one O2.5 event per fixture with available goal label
standalone_global_scorecard.dependent_lines: never treated as independent fixtures; fixture-balanced aggregation required
